title: mcp-recon v0.1 classification document
description: Wire-format JSON Schema for the artifact emitted by `mcp-recon classify`. The TypeScript interface `ClassificationResults` (packages/mcp-recon-cli/src/classify/types.ts) is the source of truth for the shape; this JSON Schema is downstream and exists so any-language consumer can validate documents tagged `mcp-recon/v0.1/classification`.

schema.description: Schema-version tag. The single enforceable invariant of the document.

scanned_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which `mcp-recon classify` produced the document.

fuzz_informed.description: Whether fuzz results were folded into confidence (raises confidence by 0.1).

confused_deputy_candidate.description: The load-bearing flag: tool takes user-controllable string args AND has write/destructive/privileged authority.

confidence.description: Combined confidence in [0, 1] per noisy-OR over fired rules.

rationale.description: Free-form rationale listing every rule that fired and its weight.

recommended_caveat.description: Suggested capnagent caveat for this tool — copy-pasteable, with `<your-...>` placeholders for operator bindings.

classifications.rationale: name match → filesystem/read (0.70); description match → filesystem/read (0.50); schema: arg "path" is path-shaped → filesystem (0.40)
classifications.recommended_caveat: tool == "read_file" AND caller == "<your-caller-id>" AND arg.path starts_with "<your-sandbox-prefix>/" AND now <= @<your-cap-expiry>  // READ filesystem
